_note: Floor 4 of the Drambus Stack, and one sitting. `outside` is what makes it one: beating the boss puts you back in the field and a save taken inside reopens there too, so a floor is a thing you go in and finish or do not. Ten by ten, one thing at the end of it, and the next entry is a different map because the tower is a floor shorter. Which floor the door opens onto is derived from what has been answered rather than from a counter — the boss tiles are the record, and the order they come down in is the whole of the condition.

places.name: what is standing on floor 4
prose: It settles again, and this time somebody at the tally shed is standing outside it with a pencil before the noise has finished.
"Two," he says. "Two in a week. Six years and then two in a week." He writes it down and looks at the page and does not look happy about it. Three floors left.
